strengths: Extensive, proven software engineering experience across many domains (web, mobile, embedded, backend)
Strong track record with agile practices, TDD, CI/CD, and architecture design
Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing (workshops, talks, open source)
concerns: Severely overqualified for an entry-level position, likely to be underutilized or seek exit quickly
German listed as only 'Basic', not meeting the required strong communication level
Minimal recent hands-on Java experience; current stack is TypeScript/Node.js and D, not Java-focused
